commitResults.messageTitle: Fix search command and parent email issues
commitResults.messageBody:
The search command just fails if a parent's email field is empty, and
users are unable to remove emails with edit-parent, and one student
cannot have more than two parents.

This undermines the functionality of these features, which make the user
experience worse in general.

Let's update the code for email, search and parents to allow for these
features.

This would ensure that such features are kept working properly for a
good user experience.
Fix search command and parent email issues

commitResults.messageTitle: Make Esc close the User Guide window
commitResults.messageBody: The help window opened by F1 is a separate window, so the main window's Esc shortcut never reached it and keyboard users had no way to close it. It now hides itself when Esc is pressed. The User Guide and Developer Guide mention the new key, and tests check that Esc closes the window and other keys leave it open.
Make Esc close the User Guide window
